top_news.title: When Forgetting Looks Like Improvement: Metric Masking in Streaming Diarizer Adaptation and the Price of Rehearsal
top_news.dek: Small-data adaptation in streaming diarizers can improve in-domain performance while masking significant degradation in speaker attribution.
top_news.brief: Researchers found that adapting streaming diarizers on small datasets leads to inconsistent performance across evaluation corpora. While in-domain diarization improves, the model often suffers from catastrophic forgetting, where gains in one metric hide losses in others.

top_news.title: AI-powered hacking tools enabled a likely single attacker to breach multiple South Korean banks
top_news.dek: A single attacker breached multiple South Korean banks using the open-source AI tool ARTEX for automated penetration testing.
top_news.brief: CrowdStrike reports that a suspected Chinese-speaking actor used ARTEX—which leverages models like DeepSeek and GLM-5.3—to exfiltrate over 25,000 customer records from Shinhan Bank. The incident highlights how AI-powered tools lower the barrier for individuals to execute large-scale data breaches.

top_news.title: [AINews] Claude Haiku 5.5 — better than GPT-6 Luna at the same pricing
top_news.dek: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5, offering performance improvements over GPT-6 Luna at the same price point.
top_news.brief: The latest iteration of the Haiku model series brings updated capabilities to Anthropic's small-model lineup. Benchmarks suggest it outperforms competing models like GPT-6 Luna in efficiency and reasoning tasks while maintaining existing pricing.

top_news.title: OpenAI annualised revenues $20B less than previously signalled
top_news.dek: OpenAI's annualized revenue figures are reportedly lower than previously estimated.
top_news.brief: Recent financial reporting suggests that OpenAI's annualized revenue is significantly below earlier projections. The discrepancy highlights the challenges in accurately forecasting growth for rapidly scaling AI infrastructure companies.
top_news.image_alt: Financial chart showing revenue growth trends

top_news.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
top_news.dek: OpenAI has disrupted influence operations using AI to create fake journalists and think tanks.
top_news.brief: OpenAI identified and terminated accounts linked to covert influence campaigns. These operations utilized AI-generated content to simulate legitimate journalistic and academic output to spread geopolitical messaging.
top_news.image_alt: Network diagram representing disrupted influence operations

primary.title: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
primary.summary: Zenity Labs researchers say a single publicly accessible AI agent on Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore was enough to take over every AgentCore agent in the same AWS account and region. The attack exploited an internal AWS interface for temporary cloud credentials that agents could reach without restriction. AWS has since patched the issue and significantly tightened the agents' default permissions. The article A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found appeared first on The Decoder.
